about: Posting log for the @scanthegoodnews Instagram schedule. One entry per post. The weekly task reads this to avoid repeating verses and looks, and to find the next open date.

posts.caption: Count how many times God says "I" in Isaiah 41:10. Five. He is with us, He is our God, and He says He will strengthen us and help us, so the only thing He asks of us in this verse is not to be afraid. If something has you anxious right now, it's a good one to memorize.

Hearing the Word can feel like obeying it, and James says that's how we end up deceiving ourselves. Right after this verse he compares a hearer who doesn't act to a man who looks at himself in a mirror, walks away and forgets what he looked like. If the Word convicted you of something this week, do something about it today. Don't wait for Sunday.

Paul says in Romans 5:7 that you would hardly find anyone willing to die for a righteous person. Then in verse 8 he says Christ died for us while we were still sinners, not righteous or even good. If you've been waiting until you are good enough to come to God, He never made that a condition.

1 Peter 3:15 takes it for granted that people will ask about the hope we have, and it says to always be ready. That starts in the heart, by setting the Lord apart as holy there first. After that it takes some preparation. If someone asked you today why you have hope, could you answer in a few sentences, and do it gently?

Psalm 119 is the longest chapter in the Bible at 176 verses, and nearly every one of them is about God's Word. Verse 105 says it lights both our feet and our path. Unsure what to do this week? Read a few verses before you decide anything.
